concept.title: Term-time and time-limited access
concept.shortdesc: Conditions that limit when or for how long a person can use a service, such as term-time-only sessions, fixed stay lengths, or having to attend at set intervals.

keywords.keyword: is there a time limit on support

conbody.note: Draft category. The name and definition were written by a language model from a clustering of real service descriptions, and no person has reviewed them.

ul.li: length of stay about three months
attend at least once every three months
by appointment only: see (depends on an appointment, not on dates or duration)
booking required: see (asks for a place to be reserved)
must meet service criteria: belongs in a neighbouring group that is not yet a category (general qualifying criteria rather than timing)

strow.stentry: Draft, not reviewed. The group re-formed in most resamplings of the data (stability 0.65).
Shropshire (14), Dorset (8), North Lincolnshire (4), Open Sessions (3), Lancashire (1)

Mixed: the group holds more than one kind of service. It would split into term-time-only sessions, and time-limited stays or attendance rules (about three months, pre- and post-release, one day only, ticket-only entry).
